en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a central monument surrounded by a low balustrade, steps, and ornate streetlamps. Around the square stand several four‑ to five‑story historicist buildings with shops and hotels on the ground floor. A statue of a standing figure is on a tall pedestal in the middle. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the cobbled square; horse‑drawn vehicles are visible. On the façade of the right‑hand hotel a large sign reads "DRESDNER HOF" and "HOTEL ZUM DRESDNER HOF," while shop signs in German are visible on the left. In the background, on a hill, are detached houses overlooking the town.
